pynq_demo.description: The PYNQ-Z2 demo: raw Bayer frames in over HDMI as bayerlink, the revela ISP, a genlocked raster out over HDMI -- the camera on a TV.

pipeline.description: The ISP this demo builds, by reference: a composite of revela's blocks, generated and proved as part of this design.

mode.description: The output raster. By default the one the input arrives in, so the output runs at the input's rate, genlocked to it.

link_mode.description: The raster the receiver advertises in its EDID: payload plus one header row. Its clock is the link's, and the HDMI front end is built for the span it falls in: 1080p60's 148.5 MHz, the most this board's input takes, so a source sends as many samples a second as the receiver can take.

isp_mhz.description: The clock the pipeline is CUT for, above the clock it runs at: generation margin makes the cut placement deterministic.

capture.description: Build the link-judge path: byte-exact frames to DDR, so the ARM can convict a cable or a lane map.

rx_fifo.description: The receiver's sample FIFO depth, pinned: a different depth is a different design.

max_line_bytes.description: The longest packed camera line the receiver holds.

fill.description: What the raster paints outside the picture: 0x101010.

out_khz.description: The output raster's pixel clock in kHz, from bayerlink's rasters.

fclk1_khz.description: FCLK1, the raster clock's input: the 200 MHz the processing system makes.

raster_divclk.description: Rows 1 and 2's recipe: 200 MHz / 10 x 37.125, a 742.5 MHz VCO, divides to 74.25 and 148.5 MHz.

tv_khz_rows.description: The display clocks this board makes, row by row of its clock select: 480p's, the 720p/1080p family's, and 1080p50/60's. Rows 1 and 2 share one clock manager's VCO.

raster27_divclk.description: Row 0's recipe: 200 MHz / 8 x 27, a 675 MHz VCO, divides to 27 MHz.

sample_bits.description: The depth of one sample into the ISP, as the design reads it from the ISP: for the capture path.

isp_out_bits.description: The ISP's output word, as the design reads it from the ISP.

layout_id.description: The checksum of this build's GPIO layout, which software reads back to know gpio_layout.json is this bitstream's: supplied by the build, which derives it from the declarations below.

ps7.description: The processing system, on the board's preset. FCLK0 is every AXI clock here, at 142.857143 MHz: 142.86 rather than 100 so the island and the display merge into one clock and a fractional MMCM is retired. FCLK1 is the 200 MHz the HDMI front end calibrates its delays with.

fabric.description: The camera-on-a-display design, filled with this board's ISP and fed this board's clocks and resets.

build.ps_per_pixel: @revela.boards.common.clocking:fine_steps(fclk1_khz, raster27_divclk, raster27_mult8, out_khz) if out_khz == tv_khz_rows[0] else @revela.boards.common.clocking:fine_steps(fclk1_khz, raster_divclk, raster_mult8, out_khz)

clk_raster.description: The display clock's rows 1 and 2: 74.25 MHz and 148.5 MHz from one VCO, steered by the genlock.

clk_raster27.description: The display clock's row 0: 27 MHz, steered by the genlock while chosen.

clk_sel.description: The display clock, row 0 or row 1, as the raster's register file says.

tmds_pll.description: The serializer's PLL: five times the chosen pixel clock, reprogrammed by the firmware with each display clock's recipe.

tmds_clk.description: The serializer's bit and pixel clocks, regional, from the PLL beside it.

control.description: Software's bits into the fabric. Power-on defaults say what the board IS: the ISP is the stream's consumer and the direct picture is on, so a freshly programmed board shows the camera with no software running.

parameters.capture: Whether the capture path, and so a consumer to select, is built.
parameters.layout_id: The checksum of the build's GPIO layout.

fields.name: broom
fields.description: The software reset: clears the receiver's sticky tallies, restarts the raster and the capture crossing. A person saying start again.

fields.name: consumer
fields.description: The stream's consumer: 1 the ISP, 0 the judge's byte-exact capture.

fields.name: grab
fields.description: The grabber's branch of the tee: quasi-static, honoured at frame boundaries, off at power-on so the write engine never touches memory nobody allocated.

fields.name: direct
fields.description: The direct picture's branch of the tee; it also makes the raster follow the stream.

fields.name: layout_id
fields.description: The checksum of the build's GPIO layout: a script refuses a gpio_layout.json that does not match the bitstream it is reading.

status.description: The fabric's testimony, two words: the link, the island, the header's verdicts; and the capture spy, the raster's lock and its own status.

fields.name: link_locked
fields.description: The HDMI front end's pixel clock is locked.

fields.name: rx_overflow
fields.description: The receiver lost samples: sticky, cleared by the broom.

fields.name: island_reset
fields.description: The island is held in reset (it follows the link).

fields.name: isp_in_valid
fields.description: The stream is reaching the ISP.

fields.name: isp_in_ready
fields.description: The ISP is accepting.

fields.name: isp_out_valid
fields.description: The ISP is producing.

fields.name: shim_in_valid
fields.description: The pixel side is offering the island a sample.

fields.name: shim_in_ready
fields.description: The pixel side's sample was accepted.

fields.name: raster_clkin_stopped
fields.description: The raster clock's input has stopped: why it is not locked, if it is not.

fields.name: raster_clkfb_stopped
fields.description: The raster clock's feedback has stopped.

fields.name: refused
fields.description: The receiver refused a frame: sticky.

fields.name: refuse_code
fields.description: Why: 1 magic, 2 fourcc, 3 group.

fields.name: hdr_bits
fields.description: The depth the last accepted header declared.

fields.name: hdr_valid
fields.description: A header has been accepted.

fields.name: hdr_phase
fields.description: The CFA phase the last header declared.

fields.name: spy_status
fields.description: The capture crossing's spy: who refuses, producer or consumer; zero without the capture path.

fields.name: raster_locked
fields.description: The raster's MMCM is locked.

fields.name: scanout_status
fields.description: The raster's own status word, as raster.v lays it out.

stream.description: Which frame, and which camera: the stream's identity and the link's own testimony, as counts, so a poll that misses an event still sees it happened.

fields.name: frame_seq
fields.description: The last accepted header's frame sequence: the frame ENTERING the pipeline.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Which camera sent it.

fields.name: resync_count
fields.description: Stream restarts, wrapping.

fields.name: link_up
fields.description: The link's settled lock.

fields.name: loss_count
fields.description: Link drops seen, wrapping.

fields.name: torn_a
fields.description: The display branch fell behind: sticky.

fields.name: torn_b
fields.description: The grabber fell behind: sticky.

cdc.description: The capture branch into FCLK0, where the DMA runs: np2hw's stream crossing, reset by the broom on both sides, as the capture path is.

one.description: A one, for a reset whose clock needs no lock.

rst_bus.description: The register bus's reset, on the bus clock: the processor's fabric reset, and nothing the link does.

link_rst_n.description: The link's reset, active low, for the ISP side's synchroniser.

rst_isp.description: The ISP side's reset, on its clock: the link's reset, held until its clock is locked.

gp0.description: The processor's general-purpose port onto the register bus.

gp0_slice.description: Registers between the processor's port and the bus: the port's outputs are slow out of the hard block, and without this the bus was one combinational path from them to every register file's write decode.

regs.description: The register bus: each slave at the window it states, placed in the processor's general-purpose region.

mem.description: The DMAs' writes onto the processor's memory port.

tx_cdc.description: The raster into the serializer's pixel clock: a regional divider of the bit clock, the raster's frequency at a phase chance sets on each relock.

pins.name: FIXED_IO
pins.description: The processor's MIO, clock and resets.
